title: Plex (LinuxServer.io)
description: Plex organises video, music and photos from personal media libraries and streams them to smart Tvs, streaming boxes and mobile devices. This container is packaged as a standalone Plex Media Server. Straightforward design and bulk actions mean getting things done faster.
